SocialPause 0.6.0 brings the V2.1 design, flexible lunch controls, and configurable individual/shared timers to the offline Android app.

- Persistent light/dark appearance, an Individual / Shared selector, app allowance sliders, and a Lunch wheel picker.
- Instagram allows 0–7 minutes; other selected apps allow 0–12. Shared allowance is configurable from 1–30 minutes. Each app still starts its own 60-minute cooldown when its limit is reached; exhausting shared time starts a group cooldown.
- One manual lunch per day, early Stop lunch, and lunch schedule edits that apply today when eligible or tomorrow otherwise.
- Fixed app-selection saving and automatic monitoring shutdown when Accessibility permission is removed.
- Preserved active timers, cooldowns, history and lunch records on upgrades from 0.3/0.4/0.5, including active older shared allowances above 30 minutes.
- GitHub Actions now runs the timing suite on Java 17 and 21, builds an Android APK, and runs lint on pushes and pull requests.

Download **SocialPause.apk** for installation. Version code **8** uses the existing signing certificate, so it can update a previous official APK without uninstalling. This remains the project's personal-install debug build, not a Play Store build. Android 13 or newer is required; the intended phone is the Galaxy S24 Ultra on Android 16.

The timing suite covers **129 scenarios and 20,000 randomized reference-model transitions**. Local Android 16 emulator checks covered the redesign, upgrades, timers, notifications and permission handling. Samsung-specific rendering and behavior remain device checks; CI does not emulate One UI.

Sleep Time hides both drawer notifications and the live countdown by default from **10 PM to 10 AM**, while limits remain active. On the tested Samsung, keep **Developer options → Live notifications for all apps** enabled for the live countdown.

**SHA256SUMS.txt** verifies the APK, source archive and build information. **BUILD-INFO.txt** records the source commit, app version and public signing-certificate fingerprint. CI's separately labelled test APK uses a temporary key and is not the update APK.
